doc.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 23, 2003 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Goofy gigs: Tiny Tim's wedding and Ryan's Hope
summary: He tuned Tiny Tim's ukulele on The Tonight Show wedding and played guitar for a soap-opera actress with a stand-in on camera.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: What’s the goofiest thing that ever happened to you in the music business? Is it possible for you to remember that?
Well I don’t know goofy, but I played Tiny Tim’s wedding you know.
That’s right. God I remember that.
Yeah. I tuned his ukulele for him and all that stuff.
You tuned his ukulele? Oh. How do you tune a ukulele?
I can imagine that scene. The guys in the band must have been like —

Oh I know. Another thing on the soap opera “Ryan’s Hope” once I did, I got called to play for Helen Gallagher or somebody, one of those great actresses that used to do the show. And the producer had me come in with my guitar and he says, “Well can you find another guitar that looks like yours?” I says yeah. I went down to Carol’s and looked for something that matched. So I was playing the guitar and they showed my half of my body playing the guitar and the other half was the guy who wasn’t playing the guitar.

I’m not kidding. I did that. Yeah. Yup. When you saw him playing, and then they’d shoot to him while he was singing and I’m playing the guitar. I was playing all the way through the whole thing anyway.
Yeah they did all kinds of tricks. They don’t do that today though.
